newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela Banco Mercantil to up capital.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela Banco Mercantil to up capital.

text.p: Venezuela's second largest bank Banco Mercantil is to increase its capital through a simultaneous offering of Type A and B shares, Venezuela's stock exchange said.
Twenty million Type A shares and 12.5 million Type B shares will be issued, each with a nominal value of 100 bolivars, paid out of non-distributed profits.
The shares will then be distributed to current shareholders at the rate of one new share for each two currently held, the exchange said.
Some 40 million Mercantile Type A shares are currently outstanding, and some 24.96 million Type B shares. Type B shares have limited voting rights.
